page_title: CHE 1-1 CRY | Chelsea v Crystal Palace 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+8' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
90+7' A long ball forward to Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is intercepted.

90+6' Joao Felix (Chelsea) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
90+5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

90+4' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Dean Henderson guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

90+3' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
90+2' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90+1' Yellow card! It's like Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jarred Gillett agrees and books him.
90+1' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is behind the touchline and Chelsea will take a throw-in.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' The yellow card goes to Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace).
88' Oliver Glasner has decided to make a change. Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) replaces Daichi Kamada.
88' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempts to find Marc Cucurella, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Noni Madueke walks off the pitch to be replaced by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea).
86' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
84' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:6.
79' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
78' A dangerous looking corner kick from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is cleared to safety by the defence.

77' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Robert Sanchez stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
77' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

77' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
76' Jarred Gillett blows for a foul after Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
74' Enzo Maresca is forced to make a change. Malo Gusto is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea).
72' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) tries to find Ismaila Sarr, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
70' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
69' A substitution has been made. Jean-Philippe Mateta goes off and Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) comes on.
67' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
63' The expression of the referee Jarred Gillett is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is shown a yellow card.
62' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
61' Joao Felix (Chelsea) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
58' A substitution has been made. Pedro Neto is replaced by Joao Felix (Chelsea).
57' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace). It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.
55' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.

53' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Robert Sanchez, so the score changes to 1:1.
53' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
52' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
52' Half-chance! Malo Gusto (Chelsea) plays a pass into the box, but Dean Henderson reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) for Will Hughes.
50' The corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is hurriedly cleared.

49' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Chelsea.
49' Corner kick. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is ready to send the ball into the box.

49' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Dean Henderson to dive and make a save. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Rough tackle by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Chelsea are awarded the free kick.
47' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) took a mid-range free kick and failed to find the target. The goalkeeper didn't need to react at all as his attempt went miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
45+2' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Crystal Palace.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Chelsea.

43' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

42' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Dean Henderson. This effort really didn't trouble him.
40' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
39' The ball is cleared after Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
39' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
38' A pass from Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is intercepted by Dean Henderson and the move breaks down.
37' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
37' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
35' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
32' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
32' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle as Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
32' A lofted cross from Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

31' That was close by Noni Madueke (Chelsea)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
31' A cross into the box from Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
29' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
27' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

25' 1 - 0 Cole Palmer is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 1:0.
24' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

24' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) produces a powerful first-time shot from close range towards the top of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an astonishing save and pushes the ball onto the crossbar. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
23' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
23' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.

22' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
21' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

16' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Robert Sanchez has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
13' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

12' What a chance that is! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

11' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Chelsea.
10' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
10' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
8' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
6' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jarred Gillett has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
4' A pass from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is intercepted by Dean Henderson and the move breaks down.
2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will officiate today.
